description: Run before buying, accepting or recommending a token. Answers SAFE, CAUTION or AVOID with the exact reasons, from on-chain and market data. Simulates a real holder selling, checks whether the liquidity can be pulled, the creator's record, insider wallet networks, what the issuer can do (mint, freeze, Token-2022 traps), verification, liquidity, holders and age, and turns that into one verdict. Inputs: token: The token's address. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/token_safety.
name: token_safety
